text: An Android app for video consultations with doctors in tier-2 cities. A patient picks a doctor, pays the fee, joins the video call and gets a prescription PDF afterwards. Doctors set the hours they are available. It has to work on a weak connection.
notes: Android is an explicit platform (P-04 PRESENT). Video calling and payment are both categories with no provider named. A domain of Healthcare or Telemedicine both count; Mobile alone would not.
